title: Sky
wikitext:
'''The Sky''' is a holding area considered to be a [[street]] that is connected to every street area in [[Arkham]]. 

[[Monster_movement#Flying_Monsters|Flying monsters]] in the Sky can swoop down on investigators on any street during the [[Monster movement]] portion of the [[Mythos phase]]. 

Monsters in the Sky still count towards the [[monster limit]].
